comment: The three buttons carry no lettering on the panel; their names here come from the configParam strings at OrestesOne.cpp:469-471 and from what expMemPrevModule, expMemNextModule and enableLearn(LEARN_MODE::MEM) do in OrestesOneWidget.cpp:303-318.
